in_marathi.name: Rudra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth, Fertility
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudra is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which is considered a powerful god in Hindu mythology. He is the god of rudimentary forces of nature, such as storms, wild animals, and disease. Rudra is also known as the 'Lord of Wealth' and 'Fertility', as he is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in life.
